body.text: Applications to the Harbor Archive Open Studio are in time only when submitted strictly after 2026-12-04T09:00:00.125Z and at or before 2026-12-19T18:00:00.875Z. An on-time applicant must qualify through at least one of the two routes below. Youth route: all three requirements apply: age is at least 15 and at most 19; guardian consent is present; and at least one of these alternatives holds: (a) the applicant is a resident and is not a member, or (b) the applicant is a student and has a scholarship. Adult route: the applicant must be at least 20 years old AND must satisfy at least one of these alternatives: (a) the applicant is a member and is not a student, or (b) the applicant is a resident and also either does not have a scholarship or is a student. The age requirement applies to both adult alternatives. There is one additional requirement for every route: for a submission strictly after 2026-12-14T10:30:00.500Z, the applicant must either have a scholarship, or must both be a member and have guardian consent. At or before that instant, this additional requirement does not apply. Everyone else is rejected. Only admitted applicants have a fee. Use the first matching fee in this order, in USD cents: scholarship AND membership, 350; scholarship, 900; age at most 19, 1700; resident AND student, 2300; membership, 3200; otherwise, 4700.
